history.title: Chat History
history.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this conversation?

thread.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this thread? All chat history will be lost.

deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this workspace? All threads will be lost.
deleteRemoteNote: This will not delete the workspace in your remote instance.

embedding.title: Embedding Settings
embedding.saveError: Embedding settings could not be saved

multilingual-e5-small.label: Multilingual E5 Small
multilingual-e5-small.description: 100+ languages, fast & tiny. Best for low-RAM devices.

nomic-embed-text-v2-moe.label: Nomic Embed v2 MoE (Multilingual)
nomic-embed-text-v2-moe.description: ~100 languages, MoE, Matryoshka dims. Best quality.

dimensions.label: Embedding Dimensions
dimensions.matryoshkaDescription: Matryoshka truncation: smaller dimensions = faster search, less storage. 256 dims retains ~99% quality.
dimensions.fixedDescription: This model has fixed dimensions. Switch to Nomic v2 MoE for Matryoshka truncation.

autoDetect.label: Auto-detect Language
autoDetect.description: Automatically detect document language and route to optimal embedder. When disabled, uses selected engine for all documents.

reembed.label: Re-embed Workspace
reembed.description: Re-process all documents with current embedding settings. This will delete existing vectors and create new ones.
reembed.confirmMessage: This will re-process all documents in this workspace using the current embedding engine and dimensions. Existing vectors will be replaced. This operation cannot be undone and may take several minutes.
